title: Back to comp first
question: Comp first again: from here the drawing leads and the build follows it. These two are where the code stands right now - they stay as the reference for whatever we draw next.

options.label: The tubes, narrower
options.thesis: The channel went from 44px to 34px because that is the ratio the comp actually has - the tubes were reading as fat capsules instead of channels cut into the surface. The panel now has real relief against the ground, and the percentage row above each tube is gone: the value against its target underneath already says it.
options.viewport: Header, day switch, the four tubes, diet quality, water.
options.risk: In Hebrew the tubes run right to left, so calories sit on the RIGHT - mirrored from every comp we drew in English. And the grams still print a Latin g on a Hebrew screen.

options.label: The write-line and the meals
options.thesis: The one lit bar on the screen, with its amber disc, over the meals on a single panel with rules made of light. The content now clears the tab bar - the plus button was sitting on top of the water card before this pass.
options.viewport: The lit write-line, today's meals, the tab bar.
options.risk: The plus button still half-overlaps the tab bar, and the Better/Me bar is heavy for a phone.
